title: TrawMem: Reframing Agent Memory as Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.36918v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on memory systems to leverage long-term interactions, yet existing systems typically retrieve memories based on their relevance to the current query and use them as contextual evidence. However, relevance alone does not characterize how a memory contributes to task solving: the same memory may serve different roles across tasks, such as directly supporting the answer or linking to complementary memories with weaker semantic relevance but necessary information. We therefore reframe agent memory systems as Task-Oriented Role-Adaptive Workspaces, where memories are selected and organized by their task-oriented roles and relations. Based on this view, we propose TrawMem, which organizes interaction histories into local threads and constructs task-oriented workspaces by assigning roles and jointly selecting complementary memories. translated_title: TrawMem：将智能体记忆重新构建为面向任务的角色自适应工作区
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体依赖记忆系统来利用长期交互信息，然而现有系统通常基于与当前查询的相关性来检索记忆，并将其作为上下文证据使用。然而，仅有相关性并不能刻画一条记忆对任务解决的贡献方式：同一条记忆在不同任务中可能扮演不同角色，例如直接支持答案，或者作为桥梁链接到语义相关性较弱但包含必要信息的互补记忆。因此，我们将智能体记忆系统重新构建为面向任务的角色自适应工作区，其中记忆根据其面向任务的角色和关系被选择和组织。基于这一视角，我们提出了TrawMem，它将交互历史组织为局部线程，并通过分配角色和联合选择互补记忆来构建面向任务的工作区。在LoCoMo和MemGallery数据集上使用四个开源和闭源骨干模型的实验……
tldr: 该论文提出TrawMem，将智能体记忆系统重新构想为面向任务的角色自适应工作区，通过为记忆分配任务角色并联合选择互补记忆来组织交互历史，从而突破传统仅基于相关性的记忆检索范式。
en_tdlr: TrawMem reframes agent memory as task-oriented role-adaptive workspaces, organizing interaction histories into local threads and jointly selecting complementary memories by their task roles, moving beyond relevance-only memory retrieval.
